preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of stones N for each player must be between 1 and 100,000.
The lengths of strings A and B must both equal N.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: All characters in strings A and B must be lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output string S must have a length of 2 * N.
The output string S must be the lexicographically smallest arrangement of all stones from both players.
